snippet.title: Hot Water Breaks In Football Boots Faster? Myth Or Fact #bootclinicfc # #footballboots
snippet.description:
Hot water breaks in your boots faster. Myth or fact?

Myth. Heat weakens the glue that holds the upper to the soleplate, and it dries out leather so it stiffens and can crack. Synthetic uppers can lose their shape too.

The safe way to break in new boots is to wear them in short sessions and build up gradually.

Performance is everything.

snippet.title: Breastfeeding Edition: Myth vs. Fact...
snippet.description:
Breastfeeding Edition: Myth vs. Fact...

🔴 Myth:

- The football hold is the best position to start with.
- Cutting out full-fat dairy helps your milk supply.
- A bullseye latch is the goal.
- Birth control at 6 weeks has zero impact on milk production.
- Sterilizing pump parts and bottles after every feed is mandatory.
- You can learn your entire feeding plan off social media.

🟢 Fact:

- The football hold is often the hardest because you end up fighting gravity the entire feed.
- Full-fat dairy is great for supply, and cutting those calories without replacing them can hurt your output.
- You need an asymmetrical latch with more areola below than above.
- Birth control at 6 weeks absolutely can impact breastfeeding, depending on the specific type you take.
- Plain soap and water for pump parts and bottles gets the job done since nothing stays sterile anyway.
- TikTok can't analyze your baby's latch or check your pump cup setup. A virtual IBCLC can.
